title: Phase C R1 — provenance-bound operator_goal: only the trusted operator goal may mint Goal Contract, network, delivery, and language authority
description: ROOT CAUSE on BASE 3737fc4: boundMissionGoal emits '[BUSINESS …]' + operator goal + an '[AGENT CONTEXT — last N outcomes]' bullet section; every authority-derivation site (extractGoalContract, extractGoalHosts, network-demand, detectTelegramDeliveryIntent, detectOutputLanguage, planner sanitize, runtime revalidation) consumed the whole enriched string, so history bullets minted fabricated OBL_*/DEL_*, authorized context URLs, and delivery/language intent → FAIL_CLOSED_PLAN_INCOMPLETE → PLANNER_RUN_EXHAUSTED → INTEGRITY_FAULT. Audit R1 rejected format-based inference (stripped genuine operator Markdown). FIX — provenance, not parsing: canonical mission field operator_goal is pinned at the seams — startBoundMission derives it from the loaded work_item row, preview/confirm digest-bind it into mission_input + effective_input_digest, service reserves it (metadata shadowing → FAIL_CLOSED_METADATA_AUTHORITY_SHADOWING), legacy bound rows recover it via bound_open_id → work_item.goal. All authority sites resolve operatorGoalOf(mission); the enriched envelope still reaches the planner prompt verbatim as context. Coverage/dataflow/source-auth/executor governance, digests, pinned plans, retry/idempotency unchanged. 28 regressions: bare/enriched parity, operator Markdown authority, context URL/Telegram/language non-authority, delegated e2e, preview/confirm/replay, legacy recovery, drift/shadowing fail closed.
